info.title: Arena of Ideas
info.description: The game's HTTP JSON API, generated from src/mvp/routes.ts. Battle logs follow battle-events/1 (protocol/battle-events.md). /api/v1 and battle-events/1 only gain things (fields, routes, event and type kinds); renaming or removing one means /api/v2. A client ignores fields and event types it doesn't know. Agent clients send X-Arena-Client: agent/<name> and play practice runs only (assist only, #958).

client.name: X-Arena-Client
client.description: #958, assist only: `agent/<name>` from an agent client (MCP, the Claude Code mod). It may read, preview, log in and play practice runs; other writes answer 403.

token.name: X-Arena-Token
token.description: A PlayerSession token (invite, join, email or Telegram login).

player.name: X-Arena-Player
player.description: A device player id, open servers only (POST /players).
